meta.title: AgroPulse
meta.description: AgriTech & B2B olive oil supply-chain platform for Greece and Turkey.

landing.headline: Olive quality. Transparent market. One system.
landing.subhead: Farmers log sprays and scans; AI computes risk and a quality score; mills buy with full traceability.
landing.phaseNote: Phase 4: screens are ready. Connect Supabase / Gemini / Mapbox keys for full live mode.
